::: {#exr-chain}

#### The probability of a word

Let $X_1, X_2, X_3$ be the next three characters of a text.
Use the [chain rule of probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/probability.html#thm-chain-rule) to write $\Pr(X_1 = \texttt{t}, X_2 = \texttt{h}, X_3 = \texttt{e})$
as a product of three probabilities,
each about one character.

:::
